steps.code:
# Let's read all notes and parse their content
notes_data = []
for note_info in all_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_info['note_id'], access_token=login_response['access_token'])
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    title = note['title']
    date_str = title.replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '').strip()
    # Parse content: lines after the header line
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Find the line that starts with "exercised" or the first habit line
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            if len(parts) == 2:
                habit_name = parts[0].strip()
                value = parts[1].strip().lower()
                if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                    habits[habit_name] = value
    notes_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})
print(f"Parsed {len(notes_data)} notes")
print(notes_data[0])

import csv
from io import StringIO

# Sort notes by date ascending
